models.name: todo_app_guests
models.description:
Stores temporary guest identifiers for unauthenticated visitors.

Guests are anonymous users who have not yet signed up or logged into the application. Each guest record represents a unique unauthenticated visitor tracked by the system. Guest records do not store any personal information, credentials, or persistent user data — they serve only as lightweight identifiers for anonymous sessions. When a guest transitions to a {@link todo_app_members} account via sign-up or login, or when their session expires, the guest record is hard-deleted in accordance with the policy that all guest data is discarded without recovery.

Guest session details such as tokens, IP addresses, and expiration timestamps are stored separately in {@link todo_app_guest_sessions}, which maintains a one-to-many relationship with this table.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. A unique identifier generated for each unauthenticated guest visitor.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of this guest record. Set automatically when the guest identifier is first created to track when the anonymous session began.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of this guest record. Updated whenever the guest record is modified.

models.name: todo_app_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary session tokens for anonymous guest visitors, tracking their browsing activity with expiration-based security.

Each {@link todo_app_guests} can have multiple guest sessions over time, each representing a separate anonymous visit to the application. Sessions are append-only — once created, they are never modified or deleted. When a session expires (based on `expired_at`), the guest must establish a new session. The session records the client IP address, the current page URL (`href`), and the referring page URL (`referrer`) for basic analytics and security auditing. Expired sessions remain in the database as an audit trail.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key — uniquely identifies each guest session token.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_guest_id
foreignFields.description:
Foreign key to the {@link todo_app_guests} table. Identifies the guest whose anonymous session this token belongs to.

Each guest can have multiple sessions over time, each representing a separate browsing visit. This establishes the 1:N relationship between a guest and their session history.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address of the guest at session creation time. Used for basic security auditing and rate-limiting analysis.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current page URL that the guest was accessing when the session was established. Records the entry point of the session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: The HTTP referrer URL indicating which page directed the guest to the application. Empty string if no referrer was provided.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session was created and the session token became valid.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp indicating when this guest session expires. After this time, the session token is no longer valid, and the guest must establish a new session. Non-nullable for security — every session has a defined expiration boundary.

models.name: todo_app_members
models.description:
Core authentication table storing registered member accounts with email and password credentials.

Each member is uniquely identified by their email address, which serves as the login identifier and cannot be changed after account creation. Authentication is password-based using a securely hashed password. Profile data such as display name is stored in the `{@link todo_app_profiles}` table in a one-to-one relationship.

Members own all their todos (`{@link todo_app_todos}`), edit history entries (`{@link todo_app_edit_histories}`), and active sessions (`{@link todo_app_member_sessions}`). Password recovery is managed through `{@link todo_app_member_password_resets}`.

Account deletion is a hard delete — when a member deletes their account, this record and all associated data (todos, edit history, sessions, profile) are permanently removed with no recovery possible.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key — unique identifier for each member account.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address serving as the member's login identifier and identity anchor. Used during authentication and to enforce data ownership boundaries across all domain entities. Cannot be changed after account creation. Must be unique across all members.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed representation of the member's password, computed using a strong one-way hashing algorithm (e.g., bcrypt). Used during login to verify the member's identity against the provided password.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp indicating when the member account was created, set automatically upon successful registration.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp indicating when the member account record was last modified, updated automatically on password changes or other credential updates.

models.name: todo_app_member_sessions
models.description:
Stores authenticated member login sessions with origin tracking and expiration.

The {@link todo_app_member_sessions} table records each authenticated session for a {@link todo_app_members} actor. Each session captures the member's IP address, the page URL (href) where the session was initiated, and the HTTP referrer. Sessions have a creation timestamp and a mandatory expiration timestamp for security. When a session expires, the member must re-authenticate to obtain a new session. This table follows the standard session pattern and is append-only — sessions are never modified after creation.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description:
Foreign key to the {@link todo_app_members} table identifying the authenticated member who owns this session.

Each session belongs to exactly one member. A member may have multiple concurrent sessions, each tracked independently.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description:
IP address from which the session was initiated.

Used for audit logging and identifying the geographical/network origin of the session request.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description:
Full URL of the page where the session was initiated.

Captures the member's entry point URL for audit and analytics purposes.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description:
HTTP Referer header value from the session initiation request.

Indicates the previous page the member visited before starting this session, useful for navigation flow analysis.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when the session was created.

Set at session initiation and never modified.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when the session expires and becomes invalid.

Members must re-authenticate after expiration. This field is always set (non-nullable) for security purposes, ensuring all sessions have a finite lifetime.

models.name: todo_app_member_password_resets
models.description:
Stores password reset tokens with expiration timestamps for password recovery workflows.

Each {@link todo_app_members} can request a password reset, which generates a unique token with an expiration time. The token is used to verify the member's identity before allowing them to set a new password. Once used or expired, the token becomes invalid.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description:
The member who requested this password reset.

References {@link todo_app_members} as the owner of this reset request.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description:
Unique reset token used to verify the reset request.

Generated cryptographically and sent to the member's email for verification.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp when this reset token expires.

After expiration, the token can no longer be used to reset the password.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reset token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reset token was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. If set, this reset token is considered deleted or consumed.

models.name: todo_app_profiles
models.description:
One-to-one profile extension for {@link todo_app_members}, storing the display name.

Each member has exactly one profile, created alongside the member account at registration. The display name is optional at signup but can be set or updated later through profile management. The profile is permanently deleted when the member deletes their account — there is no soft-delete or trash lifecycle for profiles.

This table stores only display name data. Authentication and identity fields (email, password_hash) reside in the parent {@link todo_app_members} table. The 1:1 relationship is enforced by a unique constraint on {@link todo_app_profiles.todo_app_member_id}.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key referencing the owning member's account in {@link todo_app_members}. Enforces the exclusive 1:1 relationship — each member has exactly one profile.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Member's display name shown on their profile. Optional at account creation (section [19]) but can be set or changed later through profile management (section [11]).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this profile was created, set at account registration.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this profile was last updated, typically when the display name is changed.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description:
Core todo items created and managed by a member within their private workspace.

Each {@link todo_app_todos} belongs to exactly one {@link todo_app_members} and represents a personal task tracked by the user. A todo has a required title and optional description, start date, and due date (stored as date-only values — the time component is semantically ignored). Todos default to an incomplete state upon creation; completion is tracked via a nullable `completed_at` timestamp, where a non-null value indicates the task is complete. The `deleted_at` field enables soft-delete lifecycle management: active todos have `deleted_at IS NULL`, while deleted todos reside in the trash. Restoring a todo clears `deleted_at`, and permanent deletion removes the record entirely along with its associated edit histories.

Sorting behavior: when sorting by start_date or due_date ascending, records with null values appear at the end. Filtering supports completion status (all, complete, incomplete) via the `completed_at` field.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description:
Foreign key referencing the {@link todo_app_members} who owns this todo.

Each todo is owned by exactly one member. The member's identity is immutable after creation. This relationship enforces strict data isolation — a member can only access todos where their ID matches this field.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description:
Title of the todo item.

Must be a non-empty string. This is the primary visible label of the todo and is required at creation time.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description:
Optional detailed description of the todo.

Provides additional context beyond the title. Can be left empty or omitted at creation.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description:
Optional start date for the todo (date-only value; time component is semantically ignored).

When sorting by start date ascending, todos with a null start_date appear after all todos that have a start_date set.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description:
Optional due date for the todo (date-only value; time component is semantically ignored).

When sorting by due date ascending, todos with a null due_date appear after all todos that have a due_date set.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp indicating when the todo was marked as complete.

A null value means the todo is incomplete. A non-null value means the todo is complete, with the timestamp recording when the completion toggle occurred.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp indicating when the todo was soft-deleted and moved to trash.

A null value means the todo is active and visible in the normal todo list. A non-null value means the todo is in the trash. Restoring the todo clears this field. Permanent deletion removes the record entirely.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was last updated.

models.name: todo_app_edit_histories
models.description:
Audit log entries recording each edit made to a {@link todo_app_todos}.

Each entry captures the timestamp of when the edit occurred and the new values for any fields that were modified during that edit. Fields that remained unchanged are recorded as null. History entries are immutable after creation and are sorted from most recent to oldest. When a todo is permanently deleted, its associated edit history entries are also cascade-deleted.

Edit history is only accessible to the member who owns the parent todo, maintaining strict data isolation between users as defined in the data ownership policies.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todo_id
foreignFields.description:
Foreign key to the {@link todo_app_todos} that this edit history entry belongs to.

Each history entry is owned by exactly one todo. When the parent todo is permanently deleted, all associated edit history entries are cascade-deleted. The todo itself is owned by a member, and access to this history is restricted to that member only.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description:
Timestamp of when the edit was made.

Used for sorting history entries from most recent to oldest, as required by the edit history viewing workflow.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description:
The new title value after the edit.

Null if the title was not changed during this edit.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description:
The new description value after the edit.

Null if the description was not changed during this edit.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description:
The new start date value after the edit.

Null if the start date was not changed during this edit. Date-only values are stored with time set to midnight.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description:
The new due date value after the edit.

Null if the due date was not changed during this edit. Date-only values are stored with time set to midnight.
